_about: Dishes the open tables lack, worked out from recipes over rows the table already has (fork/tools/build_food_db.py --dishes). Each ingredient is [source, exact row name, grams as weighed into the pot]; the row's nutrients per 100 g are their sum over yield_g, the dish's weight once cooked. A name carries its other spellings after a comma, in brackets, because the table search wants every word the person types (`solanka` is not `soļanka`).

dishes.name: Solyanka, meat soup (soljanka, solanka, soļanka, seļanka)
dishes.basis: Mixed-meat solyanka: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Solyanka and common recipes (about 400 g of meats to 2 l): beef, smoked sausage, ham and frankfurters in a broth soured with pickles, tomato paste, olives and lemon.
ingredients: Sausage, smoked link sausage, pork and beef
Pickles, cucumber, dill or kosher dill
Olives, pickled, canned or bottled, green

dishes.name: Cepelinai, potato dumplings with meat (cepelīni, zeppelins)
dishes.basis: One dumpling: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cepelinai, BBC Good Food Middle East (400 g potatoes and 250 g pork mince make 4) and LRT (15 to 20 g of meat a dumpling, grated raw and boiled potato bound with potato starch). Without the sour cream or bacon sauce served on it.

dishes.name: Salmon soup, creamy (lohikeitto, laša zupa, zivju zupa ar lasi)
dishes.basis: Finnish lohikeitto: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lohikeitto and common recipes: salmon, potatoes, carrot and leek in water with cream and butter.
ingredients: Cream, fluid, light (coffee cream or table cream)

dishes.name: Grey peas with bacon, Latvian (pelēkie zirņi ar speķi)
dishes.basis: Boiled grey peas with fried bacon and onion, as common Latvian recipes make them. The table has no grey pea; dry split peas stand in, close in energy and protein.
ingredients: Peas, green, split, mature seeds, raw

dishes.name: Potato balls, fried (kartupeļu bumbiņas, potato puffs)
dishes.basis: Mashed boiled potato bound with flour and egg, rolled in breadcrumbs and fried, as common recipes make them; oil is what the balls take up (about 8 %), and frying loses about a tenth of the weight.
ingredients: Potatoes, boiled, cooked without skin, flesh, without salt
Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, unbleached

dishes.name: Salad, green, without dressing (garden salad, tossed salad, side salad)
dishes.basis: A plain side salad as common recipes make it: leaf lettuce, tomato, cucumber and sweet pepper, undressed. The survey tables have salads named for what is in them (pea, crab, chicken) and dressings, but no plain one, so "salad" logged "Salmon salad".
ingredients: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

dishes.name: Plov, chicken (chicken pilaf, pilau, palov)
dishes.basis: Central Asian plov as common recipes make it with chicken: rice cooked in the fat with chicken thigh, a lot of carrot, onion and garlic. Rice takes up about one and a half times its weight in water.
ingredients: Rice, white, long-grain, regular, raw, unenriched
Chicken, broilers or fryers, dark meat, thigh, meat only, raw

dishes.name: Khachapuri, Adjarian, cheese bread with egg (adjaruli, hachapuri)
dishes.basis: One Adjarian khachapuri: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Khachapuri and common recipes: a yeast dough boat filled with sulguni and imeruli cheese, an egg and butter. Mozzarella and feta stand in for the Georgian cheeses; the dough's water and a tenth lost in baking make up the weight.
ingredients: Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, unbleached

dishes.name: Syrniki, fried quark pancakes (syrnyky, cottage cheese pancakes, biezpiena plācenīši)
dishes.basis: Quark bound with egg, flour and sugar, shaped and fried, as common recipes make them; oil is what they take up, and frying loses about a tenth of the weight.
ingredients: Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, unbleached

dishes.name: Kharcho, beef and rice soup (harcho, kharcho soup)
dishes.basis: Georgian kharcho: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kharcho and common recipes: beef, rice, onion, tomato paste, walnuts and garlic in about 2 l of water, with coriander.
ingredients: Beef, chuck eye Country-Style ribs, boneless, separable lean and fat, trimmed to 0" fat, all grades, raw

dishes.name: Kofta, beef, grilled (kofte, kefta, köfte, beef kofta kebab)
dishes.basis: Ground beef with onion, parsley and spices, shaped on skewers and grilled, as common recipes make it; grilling loses about a quarter of the weight.
ingredients: Beef, ground, 80% lean meat / 20% fat, raw

dishes.name: Odzhakhuri, pork with fried potatoes (ojakhuri, odjakhuri)
dishes.basis: Georgian ojakhuri: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ojakhuri and common recipes: pork and potatoes fried with onion and garlic, finished with coriander; frying loses about a quarter of the meat's and the potatoes' weight.
ingredients: Pork, fresh, shoulder, whole, separable lean and fat, raw

dishes.name: Poke bowl, chicken (chicken poke)
dishes.basis: A chicken poke bowl as the chains serve it: sushi rice with roast chicken, avocado, cucumber, edamame, carrot and red cabbage, with soy sauce. Cooked weights.
ingredients: Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted
Soy sauce made from soy and wheat (shoyu)

dishes.name: Beet salad, grated, with garlic and mayonnaise (beetroot salad, grated beet salad, biešu salāti)
dishes.basis: Boiled beet, grated, with garlic and mayonnaise, as common Latvian and Russian recipes make it.

dishes.name: Chicken schnitzel, breaded, fried (chicken escalope, breaded chicken breast)
dishes.basis: Flattened chicken breast in flour, egg and breadcrumbs, pan-fried, as common recipes make it; oil is what the crumb takes up, and frying loses about a fifth of the meat's weight.
ingredients: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, unbleached

dishes.name: Pork chop with cheese, baked (karbonāde ar sieru, pork cutlet with melted cheese, pork with cheese and tomato)
dishes.basis: A Latvian canteen favourite: a pork loin chop baked under tomato, onion, mayonnaise and a cheese cap; cooking loses about a quarter of the meat's weight.
ingredients: Pork, fresh, loin, center loin (chops), boneless, separable lean and fat, raw
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

dishes.name: Chicken teriyaki (teriyaki chicken)
dishes.basis: Chicken thigh pan-fried and glazed in teriyaki sauce with ginger and garlic, as common recipes make it; without the rice.
ingredients: Chicken, broilers or fryers, dark meat, thigh, meat only, raw

dishes.name: Shawarma, chicken, wrap (chicken shawarma, chicken gyros, shawarma wrap)
dishes.basis: One wrap as the kebab shops make it: grilled chicken thigh in flatbread with cabbage, tomato, cucumber and a garlic sauce of mayonnaise and yogurt.
ingredients: Chicken, broilers or fryers, dark meat, thigh, meat only, raw
Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

dishes.name: Shashlik, pork (šašliks, pork kebab, pork skewers)
dishes.basis: Pork shoulder marinated with onion and vinegar and grilled on skewers, as common Latvian and Russian recipes make it; grilling loses about a quarter of the meat's weight, and half the onion is eaten.
ingredients: Pork, fresh, shoulder, whole, separable lean and fat, raw

dishes.name: Butter chicken (murgh makhani, chicken makhani, chicken tikka masala)
dishes.basis: Chicken thigh marinated in yogurt, simmered in tomato with butter, cream, onion, garlic, ginger and spices, as common recipes make it; without the rice. Tikka masala is close enough to answer to it.
ingredients: Chicken, broilers or fryers, dark meat, thigh, meat only, raw
Tomatoes, red, ripe, canned, packed in tomato juice

dishes.name: Thai green curry, chicken (gaeng keow wan, green curry, thai curry)
dishes.basis: Chicken in coconut milk with eggplant, bamboo shoots and basil, seasoned with fish sauce and sugar, as common recipes make it; fresh chili, garlic and ginger stand in for the paste. Without the rice.
ingredients: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Nuts, coconut milk, canned (liquid expressed from grated meat and water)

dishes.name: Liver patties, beef (aknu pankūkas, liver pancakes, liver fritters)
dishes.basis: Minced beef liver with onion, egg and flour, fried by the spoonful, as common Latvian and Russian recipes make them; frying loses about a sixth of the weight.
ingredients: Beef, variety meats and by-products, liver, raw
Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, unbleached

dishes.name: Kimchi pancake (kimchijeon, kimchi jeon)
dishes.basis: Chopped kimchi in a flour and egg batter with scallions, pan-fried, as common recipes make it; the batter's water makes up the weight, less a tenth in frying.
ingredients: Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, unbleached
Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw

dishes.name: Fish cutlets, fried (zivju kotletes, fish patties, fish cakes)
dishes.basis: Minced white fish with onion, egg and breadcrumbs, fried, as common Latvian and Russian recipes make them; frying loses about a sixth of the weight.

dishes.name: Caesar wrap, chicken (chicken caesar wrap)
dishes.basis: One wrap: a flour tortilla with roast chicken, romaine, parmesan and caesar dressing, as the cafés make it.
ingredients: Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted

dishes.name: Rassolnik, pickle soup with barley (rasolnik, rasoļņiks)
dishes.basis: Russian rassolnik: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rassolnik and common recipes: beef broth with pearl barley, pickled cucumbers, potato, carrot and onion, about 1.8 l of water.
ingredients: Beef, chuck eye Country-Style ribs, boneless, separable lean and fat, trimmed to 0" fat, all grades, raw
Pickles, cucumber, dill or kosher dill

dishes.name: Olivier salad (Russian salad, salat olivye, rasols)
dishes.basis: Olivier salad: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Olivier_salad and common recipes: boiled potato, carrot and egg with pickles, peas, boiled sausage and onion in mayonnaise. Latvian rasols is the same salad.
ingredients: Potatoes, boiled, cooked without skin, flesh, without salt
Carrots, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt
Pickles, cucumber, dill or kosher dill
Peas, green, canned, drained solids, rinsed in tap water

dishes.name: Japchae, glass noodles with beef and vegetables (chapchae)
dishes.basis: Korean japchae: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Japchae and common recipes: sweet potato glass noodles (mung bean ones stand in) with beef, spinach, carrot, onion and mushrooms in soy sauce, sesame oil and sugar; the noodles take up twice their weight in water.
ingredients: Noodles, chinese, cellophane or long rice (mung beans), dehydrated
Beef, round, top round, steak, separable lean only, trimmed to 1/8" fat, all grades, raw
Soy sauce made from soy and wheat (shoyu)

dishes.name: Chicken saganaki, with tomato and feta
dishes.basis: Chicken breast baked in tomato with onion, garlic and olive oil under feta, as Greek recipes make it; the sauce reduces by about a quarter.
ingredients: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
Tomatoes, red, ripe, canned, packed in tomato juice

dishes.name: Okroshka, cold kefir soup (okroška)
dishes.basis: Okroshka: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Okroshka made with kefir, as common recipes make it: boiled potato and egg, cucumber, radish, boiled sausage, dill and scallions, with sour cream.
ingredients: Potatoes, boiled, cooked without skin, flesh, without salt
Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw

dishes.name: Biryani, lamb (lamb biryani)
dishes.basis: Lamb marinated in yogurt and spices, layered with basmati rice and fried onion, as common recipes make it; rice takes up twice its weight in water.
ingredients: Lamb, shoulder, whole (arm and blade), separable lean and fat, trimmed to 1/4" fat, choice, raw
Rice, white, long-grain, regular, raw, enriched

dishes.name: Honey cake, layered (medovik, medus kūka)
dishes.basis: Medovik: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Medovik and common recipes: thin honey sponge layers with a sour cream and sugar filling; baking loses about a tenth of the dough.
ingredients: Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, unbleached

dishes.name: Bulgogi, pork, spicy (jeyuk bokkeum, dwaeji bulgogi, pork bulgogi)
dishes.basis: Korean spicy pork: pork shoulder stir-fried with onion in a chili, soy, sugar, garlic and sesame sauce, as common recipes make it; sriracha stands in for gochujang. Without the rice.
ingredients: Pork, fresh, shoulder, whole, separable lean and fat, raw
Soy sauce made from soy and wheat (shoyu)

dishes.name: Korean fried chicken, glazed wings (yangnyeom chicken)
dishes.basis: Chicken wings in cornstarch, double-fried and glazed in a sweet chili sauce of ketchup, sriracha (for gochujang), sugar, soy sauce, honey and garlic, as common recipes make them; oil is what they take up.
ingredients: Chicken, broilers or fryers, wing, meat and skin, raw
Soy sauce made from soy and wheat (shoyu)

dishes.name: Chili con carne, homemade (chilli con carne)
dishes.basis: Ground beef with kidney beans, tomatoes, onion and sweet pepper, spiced with chili, as common recipes make it; simmering reduces it by about a tenth. Without the rice.
ingredients: Beef, ground, 80% lean meat / 20% fat, raw
Beans, kidney, red, mature seeds, canned, drained solids
Tomatoes, red, ripe, canned, packed in tomato juice

dishes.name: Lasagna, beef, homemade (lasagne, lasagna bolognese, beef lasagna, meat lasagna)
dishes.basis: Lasagne alla bolognese as common home recipes make it: dry sheets layered with a beef, tomato, onion and carrot ragù and a béchamel of butter, flour and milk, under mozzarella and parmesan; the sheets take up the sauce's liquid, and simmering and baking lose about a seventh of the weight.
ingredients: Beef, ground, 80% lean meat / 20% fat, raw
Tomatoes, red, ripe, canned, packed in tomato juice
Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, unbleached
Milk, whole, 3.25% milkfat, with added vitamin D
